Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to Issue a writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ, or  order or direction directing the respondents to pay an amount of  Rs.4,93,544/- as stated in exhibit P4 to the petitioner which isthe amount  admitted by the respondents themselves as being a liability due to the  petitioneras part of full compensation forthwith unconditionally and  without demanding the petitioner to give affidavit surrounding the  petitioner's right to initiate legal proceedings under Sec 16(3) of the Indian Telegraph Act, 1885.
 This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition  and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and this Court's order dated  04.04.2024 and upon hearing the arguments of M/S PRAPHUL P. JOSEPH,
 V.J.JOSEPH, SAJAN PUTHENVEETTIL and SANAND RAMAKRISHNAN, Advocates for the  petitioner, SRI.MILLU DANDAPANI, Advocate for R1 and of GOVERNMENT PLEADER  for R2 and R3, the court passed the following:
 WP(C) No.13531/2023 2/2  ORDER T.M.Mathew vs M/S. Power Grid Corporation Of India Ltd on 6 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86305655/
1
In spite of the specific direction issued by this court on 04.04.2024 the admitted amount has not been disbursed to the petitioner.

If the payment is not reported on or before the next posting date this Court will be constrained to order appearance of respondents 2 and 3 and to proceed against them for violation of the directions issued by this Court.

Sd/- VIJU ABRAHAM, JUDGE 06-06-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar T.M.Mathew vs M/S. Power Grid Corporation Of India Ltd on 6 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86305655/
2
